summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a milestone agreement with Cat Lake First Nation to fund up to $4 million for development of an all-season access road in northwestern Ontario, supporting the Springpole Gold Project. The agreement coordinates with prior First Nations conditions but no financial terms (price, premium, stake) or board recommendations are involved. This is an infrastructure-development press release, not a special situation. No US-equivalent event; the 6-K reports foreign private issuer routine progress. What to watch: continued permitting and provincial engagement.
